high_level_description: stc brand style, a close-up of traditional outdoor Middle Eastern cooking, with a person in a keffiyeh pouring meat into a pot over an open flame.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A desert setting with beige sand and warm, earthy natural lighting.

elements.desc: A person wearing a traditional red and white checkered keffiyeh headscarf and dark blue clothing, pouring raw meat into a gray metal cooking pot.
A metal camping stove with visible flames beneath the pot and a partially visible metal windscreen.
